entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [SafeArea] Review how to flow content on Android behind the NavBar and the TabBar when users set SafeAreaEdges to None #32488
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • WPF Blazor Unhandled Exception causes app to freeze, unable to use DevTools #32484
  • CursorPosition not calculated correctly on behaviors events for iOS devices #32483
  • error CS8603: Possible null reference return in generated code using SourceGen #32478
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Android] Shell.FlyoutVerticalScrollMode="Disabled" does not disable scrolling #32477
    Backlog
  • [Windows] Binding RTL FlowDirection in Shell causes Flyout MenuIcon and native window controls to overlap #32476
    Backlog
  • MAUI 10.0 orientation change bug at iOS 26 #32475
  • [XSG] Reduce dead code for compiled converters #32473
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Intermittent CI Failure: File Access Issue During Build (.NET MAUI Resizetizer Task) #32472
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • [BindingSourceGen] Inaccessible property setters are not detected correctly #32469
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [XSG] Self-bindings expressed by "." path are not compiled by the source generator #32467
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Regression] RadioButton should support Null Value #32466
  • GraphicsView line stroke rendering inconsistent on Android compared to other platforms #32465
    Backlog
  • [AGR] Enable the Agent so it can interact with the app #32464
    .NET 11 Planning
  • [AGR] Fix android so it can launch directly to test #32463
    .NET 11 Planning

Closed

  • When a FlyoutPage is pushed Modally it doesn't inset the AppBarLayout #32277
    .NET 10.0 SR1
  • When the version of CommunityToolkit.Maui is greater than 9.1.1, EventToCommandBehavior does not work #32442
  • .NET 9 - MAUI Shell crashes on iOS 26 with watchdog timeout in UINavigationController layout loop #32365
  • Binding value converters yields warning with compiled bindings #32044
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • .NET 10 RC2 MauiXamlInflator - SourceGen binding issue to non-nullable properties in nullable object properties #32459
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • The type or namespace name 'MauiUIApplicationDelegate' could not be found - 10.0.0-rc.2.25504.7 #32126
  • [Android] RefreshView blocks diagonal and horizontal swipes on CarouselView since .NET 9.0.120 (SR12) #32170
